title: Creamy German Pudding with Zesty Orange Sauce
description: A rich and creamy German pudding paired with a zesty orange sauce. Perfect for a unique dessert.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the pudding and heavy cream. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the pudding thickens.
Remove the pudding from the heat and stir in the sugar until dissolved.
In a small saucepan, heat the orange marmalade over low heat until warm.
To assemble the dessert, place a scoop of the pudding in a serving dish, followed by a spoonful of the warm orange sauce.
Repeat the layers one more time, finishing with a layer of pudding on top.
Serve the dessert chilled, garnished with additional orange segments if desired.
